records.question: How many customers are there?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers FROM customers LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many orders were placed in 2024?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many orders per channel?
records.sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the average list price of all products?
records.sql: SELECT AVG(list_price) AS avg_list_price FROM products LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers are loyalty members?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS loyalty_member_count FROM customers WHERE loyalty_member = TRUE LIMIT 1000

records.question: Number of returns by return reason
records.sql: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS return_count FROM returns GROUP BY reason ORDER BY return_count DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the total refund amount across all returns?
records.sql: SELECT SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount FROM returns LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many orders were cancelled?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled' LIMIT 1000

records.question: Total amount paid by payment method
records.sql: SELECT p.payment_method, SUM(p.amount) AS amount_paid FROM payments AS p GROUP BY p.payment_method LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which store opened most recently?
records.sql: SELECT store_name FROM stores ORDER BY opened_date DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many customers are in each segment?
records.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY c.segment LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the most expensive product by list price?
records.sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.list_price FROM products AS p ORDER BY p.list_price DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many suppliers are based in each country?
records.sql: SELECT s.country, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM suppliers AS s GROUP BY s.country LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the average discount on order lines?
records.sql: SELECT AVG(order_items.discount) AS avg_discount FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many order lines have a quantity of 5?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_item_id) AS order_lines_with_quantity_5 FROM order_items WHERE quantity = 5 LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers signed up in 2023?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers FROM customers WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_date) = 2023 LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many orders per month in 2025?
records.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

records.question: List the names of Flagship stores.
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name FROM stores AS s WHERE s.store_type = 'Flagship' LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which payment method collected the most money in 2024, by payment date?
records.sql: SELECT p.payment_method, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', p.paid_date) AS day, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.paid_date) = 2024 GROUP BY p.payment_method, DATE_TRUNC('DAY', p.paid_date) ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the average refund amount for each return reason?
records.sql: SELECT r.reason, AVG(r.refund_amount) AS avg_refund_amount FROM returns AS r GROUP BY r.reason LIMIT 1000

records.question: For each channel, what fraction of orders were cancelled?
records.sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(*) AS cancelled_fraction FROM orders GROUP BY channel LIMIT 1000

records.question: Revenue by channel
records.sql:
SELECT channel, SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (1 - order_items.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY channel

records.question: What was total revenue in 2024?
records.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many stores are in each region?
records.sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM stores AS s JOIN regions AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000

records.question: Number of products in each department
records.sql: SELECT c.department, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM products AS p JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.department LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many products does each supplier provide?
records.sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM suppliers AS s JOIN products AS p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_name LIMIT 1000

records.question: Units sold by channel in 2025
records.sql: SELECT o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many distinct customers ordered through the Online channel in each customer segment?
records.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.channel = 'Online' GROUP BY c.segment LIMIT 1000

records.question: Total amount paid for orders placed through the Mobile App in 2023
records.sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount_paid FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'Mobile App' AND o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023 LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the average list price per product category?
records.sql: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.list_price) AS avg_list_price FROM products AS p JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which region do most customers live in?
records.sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders were placed at Outlet stores?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.store_type = 'Outlet' LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the total refund amount for returned order lines that had a discount?
records.sql: SELECT SUM(returns.refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount FROM returns JOIN order_items ON returns.order_item_id = order_items.order_item_id WHERE order_items.discount >= 0.10 LIMIT 1000

records.question: Average order value by channel
records.sql: SELECT o.channel, AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS avg_order_value FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.channel LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many orders did loyalty members place?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.loyalty_member LIMIT 1000

records.question: List the products in the Laptops category with a list price above 500.
records.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products AS p JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Laptops' AND p.list_price > 500 LIMIT 1000

records.question: Number of orders by store type
records.sql: SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_type LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers live in the North region?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_in_north_region FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'North' LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which product category has the highest average discount on its order lines?
records.sql: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(oi.discount) AS avg_discount FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE oi.discount > 0 GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY avg_discount DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Revenue by store region in 2025
records.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN regions AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000

records.question: Revenue by department
records.sql: SELECT c.department, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.department LIMIT 1000

records.question: Top 5 categories by gross margin
records.sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)) AS gross_margin, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)) DESC) AS rnk FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY rnk ASC LIMIT 5

records.question: What was gross margin per supplier in 2024?
records.sql:
SELECT s.supplier_name,
       SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)) AS gross_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN suppliers s ON oi.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND EXTRACT(year FROM o.order_date) = 2024
GROUP BY s.supplier_name

records.question: Revenue by customer segment and channel
records.sql: SELECT c.segment, o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.segment, o.channel ORDER BY c.segment, o.channel LIMIT 1000

records.question: Refund amount by department
records.sql:
SELECT c.department, SUM(returns.refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount
FROM returns r
JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY c.department

records.question: Number of returns by store type
records.sql: SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(*) AS return_count FROM returns AS r JOIN order_items AS oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY s.store_type ORDER BY return_count DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which supplier generated the most revenue from Online orders?
records.sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM suppliers AS s JOIN products AS p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'Online' AND o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY s.supplier_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Average order value by customer region
records.sql: SELECT r.region_name, AVG(ov.average_order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM regions AS r JOIN customers AS c ON r.region_id = c.region_id JOIN (SELECT o.customer_id, AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS average_order_value FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id) AS ov ON c.customer_id = ov.customer_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What was revenue from loyalty members in each store region in 2024?
records.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN regions AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.loyalty_member AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000

records.question: Total revenue of the Electronics department in Q4 2024
records.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.order_date) = 4 AND c.department = 'Electronics' LIMIT 1000

records.question: Units sold in the Beverages category through the Mobile App channel
records.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.channel = 'Mobile App' AND c.category_name = 'Beverages' AND o.status <> 'Cancelled' LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which store had the highest revenue in 2023?
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM stores AS s JOIN orders AS o ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2023 GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Refund amount by store region for 2024 orders
records.sql:
SELECT r.region_name, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount
FROM regions r
JOIN stores s ON r.region_id = s.region_id
JOIN orders o ON s.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN returns r ON o.order_id = r.order_item_id
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM o.order_date) = 2024
GROUP BY r.region_name

records.question: Total amount paid by payment method for Corporate customers
records.sql: SELECT p.payment_method, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount_paid FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate' GROUP BY p.payment_method LIMIT 1000

records.question: Revenue by product category for Flagship stores
records.sql:
SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN categories c ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.store_type = 'Flagship' AND o.status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY c.category_name

records.question: Number of In-Store orders per region in 2025
records.sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS in_store_order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN regions AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND o.channel = 'In-Store' GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many order lines were sold in each department through Wallet-paid orders?
records.sql: SELECT c.department, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_lines_sold FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN payments AS pa ON o.order_id = pa.order_id WHERE pa.payment_method = 'Wallet' GROUP BY c.department LIMIT 1000

records.question: Total quantity sold of products supplied by Supplier C, excluding cancelled orders
records.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN suppliers AS s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE s.supplier_name = 'Supplier C' AND o.status <> 'Cancelled' LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which customers never placed an order? Give their customer ids.
records.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE NOT customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders) LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers placed more than 20 orders?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 20 LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the average number of orders per customer, counting only customers who ordered?
records.sql: SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_orders_per_customer FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_id) AS customer_orders LIMIT 1000

records.question: Show revenue for each month of 2025 and the change versus the previous month
records.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS month, SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (1 - order_items.discount)) AS revenue, LAG(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (1 - order_items.discount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)) AS previous_month_revenue, SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (1 - order_items.discount)) - LAG(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (1 - order_items.discount))) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)) AS revenue_change FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which products have never been returned?
records.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products AS p WHERE NOT p.product_id IN (SELECT order_items.product_id FROM order_items JOIN returns AS r ON order_items.order_item_id = r.order_item_id) LIMIT 1000

records.question: Who were the top 3 customers by revenue in 2024? Return their customer ids.
records.sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: For each department, what fraction of order lines were returned?
records.sql:
SELECT c.department, COUNT(r.return_id) / COUNT(o.order_id) AS return_fraction
FROM categories c
JOIN order_items oi ON c.category_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
GROUP BY c.department

records.question: What is the gross margin divided by revenue for each department?
records.sql: SELECT c.department, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)) AS gross_margin, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS gross_margin_to_revenue_ratio FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.department LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which stores had 2024 revenue above the average store revenue for 2024?
records.sql: WITH store_revenue AS (SELECT s.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM stores AS s JOIN orders AS o ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY s.store_id), average_revenue AS (SELECT AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM store_revenue) SELECT sr.store_id, sr.revenue FROM store_revenue AS sr JOIN average_revenue AS ar ON sr.revenue > ar.avg_revenue LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers bought products from all four departments in non-cancelled orders?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.department) = 4 LIMIT 1000

records.question: Rank store regions by 2025 revenue
records.sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN regions AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

records.question: What is the cumulative revenue by month in 2024?
records.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS month, SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) AS cumulative_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers who signed up in 2024 have not placed any order?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM customers AS c WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_date) = 2024 AND NOT c.customer_id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders AS o WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024) LIMIT 1000

records.question: What fraction of 2024 revenue came from the Online channel?
records.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.channel = 'Online' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS online_fraction FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many customers placed orders in both 2023 and 2025?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2023, 2025) LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which suppliers had more than 250 returned order lines?
records.sql:
SELECT s.supplier_name, COUNT(r.return_id) AS return_count
FROM suppliers s
JOIN order_items oi ON s.supplier_id = oi.supplier_id

GROUP BY s.supplier_name

records.question: For each customer segment, what is the average total revenue per customer?

records.question: Which product had the most units sold in each department?
records.sql:
SELECT c.department, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold

JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'

ORDER BY units_sold DESC
